reduction by a periodic change of variables to a constant-coefficient system

degenerate_cases_to_resolve: zero-dimensional and scalar systems, empty index types, zero or constant coefficients, and identity dynamics
zero, negative, nonminimal, multiple, and doubled periods
local, forward-only, half-line, and global solution domains

repeated, defective, zero, or unit-circle multipliers and nontrivial Jordan blocks
zero or purely imaginary exponents and their additive branch ambiguity
continuous, piecewise-continuous, measurable, discontinuous, integrable, or unbounded coefficients
